The article Iris-mini and Iris-pro are the strongest open-weight search agents in their class appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: AllSpark 團隊發布了 Iris-mini 和 Iris-pro，這兩個開源搜尋代理是基於 Qwen 模型所建構，在其尺寸級別的開源權重模型中名列基準測試前茅。根據論文指出，訓練資料與模型也提升了其在未曾受訓過的工作上的表現，包括通用工具使用與文書處理。本文《Iris-mini and Iris-pro are the strongest open-weight search agents in their class》最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title_original: Two-year university study finds banning AI from classrooms leaves students worse off
sources.summary: A law professor spent two years testing how an AI ban, unguided AI use, and structured training affect student performance. The group without AI finished last both years. "I was wrong," the researcher writes, who had assumed that AI without guidance would do more harm than good. The article Two-year university study finds banning AI from classrooms leaves students worse off appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 有一位法律系教授花費兩年時間，測試了禁止使用 AI、無引導的 AI 使用以及結構化訓練對學生表現的影響。沒有使用 AI 的組別在兩年內都敬陪末座。「我錯了，」這位原本假設沒有引導的 AI 會弊大於利的的研究人員寫道。這篇題為「兩年期大學研究發現，在教室中禁用 AI 會讓學生的表現更糟」（Two-year university study finds banning AI from classrooms leaves students worse off）的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: This practical tutorial demonstrates how to build and accelerate machine learning workflows using NVIDIA cuML and RAPIDS. It covers GPU environment setup, zero-code scikit-learn acceleration with cuml.accel, performance benchmarking across key ML algorithms, manifold learning with UMAP and HDBSCAN, tree-model inference with FIL, and model explainability using GPU-accelerated SHAP The post Implementation of Machine Learning Workflows with NVIDIA cuML, RAPIDS, GPU Benchmarking, Explainability, Clustering, and Model Inference appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 本實用教學展示如何使用 輝達 cuML 與 RAPIDS 來建構並加速機器學習工作流程。內容涵蓋 GPU 環境設定、使用 cuml.accel 進行零程式碼的 scikit-learn 加速、跨主要機器學習演算法的效能基準測試、使用 UMAP 與 HDBSCAN 的流形學習、使用 FIL 的樹狀模型推論，以及使用 GPU 加速 SHAP 的模型可解釋性。這篇題為 Implementation of Machine Learning Workflows with 輝達 cuML, RAPIDS, GPU Benchmarking, Explainability, Clustering, and Model Inference 的文章最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

sources.title_original: Fly Language Model (FLM) Wires the Full Fruit Fly Connectome Into a Frozen 1.2B LLM, and Its Own Controls Show the Wiring Does Not Help
sources.summary: The Fly Language Model (FLM) drives all 166,700 retained neurons and 25.6 million edges of the MaleCNS fruit fly connectome with token embeddings, then adds a small learned correction to a frozen LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct backbone. Only 278,528 parameters train. The accompanying preprint reports a 0.0222 nat per token improvement over the backbone, but a parameter-matched control without the graph does slightly better in every seed. We break down the architecture, the four controls, the 0.6 per token memory bound, and what it takes to run the MIT-licensed code locally. The post Fly Language Model (FLM) Wires the Full Fruit Fly Connectome Into a Frozen 1.2B LLM, and Its Own Controls Show the Wiring Does Not Help appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 果蠅語言模型（FLM）利用標記嵌入（token embeddings）驅動雄性中樞神經系統（MaleCNS）果蠅連線組的所有 166,700 個保留神經元與 2,560 萬個邊，然後對凍結的 LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct 骨幹網路加入一個小型學習修正。僅訓練 278,528 個參數。隨附的預印本報告指出，相較於骨幹網路，每個標記（token）提升了 0.0222 nat 的效能，但在每個隨機種子中，未包含圖形且參數匹配的對照組表現皆略勝一籌。我們深入剖析其架構、四種對照組、每個標記 0.6 的記憶體限制，以及在本地端執行此 MIT 授權程式碼所需的事項。這篇文章「Fly Language Model (FLM) Wires the Full Fruit Fly Connectome Into a Frozen 1.2B LLM, and Its Own Controls Show the Wiring Does Not Help」最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

sources.title_original: Generating running routes with GPT-6 Astra and ChatGPT Work
sources.summary: Here's a neat thing I had ChatGPT Work with GPT-6 Astra (Max) do this morning: I live at <my address>. Figure out 5K and 10K running routes from me that loop from my house. Use OSM data. It worked for 27 minutes and produced exactly what I'd asked for, as both an embedded visualization and downloadable GPX file and GeoJSON files. Here's that 5K route: When I asked it how it had created the route, it replied: I used Nominatim to locate the address and Overpass to download local OpenStreetMap roads and trails , then calculated the loops locally. Frustratingly, the actual code it ran and exact details of what it did weren't visible to me in the ChatGPT UI. I see this lack of transparency is an anti-feature. By the time I thought to ask for a copy of the Python code it had used, ChatGPT was unable to provide it. This appears to be because the thread had been compacted. I think any LLM system that uses compaction needs to both preserve the pre-compacted text and make that text available via agent tool calls, to protect against this kind of problem. As for displaying the map to me, that used the visualize skill . It created a file called /workspace/el-granada-5k-share.html to embed directly into the ChatGPT UI. Here's a copy of that HTML , which starts like this: < div id =" eg-share-loop " > < div class =" viz-row " > < h3 > El Granada harbor loop </ h3 > < span class =" text-small " > 5.1 km </ span > </ div > < div id =" eg-share-stage " > </ div > < div class =" text-small text-muted " > Map data © < a href =" https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright " target =" _blank " rel =
sources.summary_zh: 以下是我今天早上讓 ChatGPT 搭配 GPT-6 Astra (Max) 做的一件酷事：我住在 <my address>。請幫我規劃從我家出發並繞回臺的 5 公里與 10 公里跑步路線。使用 OSM 資料。它運作了 27 分鐘，精準產出了我要求的成果，同時提供了嵌入式視覺化畫面以及可下載的 GPX 與 GeoJSON 檔案。這是那個 5 公里路線：當我詢問它是如何建立這條路線時，它回答：我使用 Nominatim 來定位地址，並使用 Overpass 來下載當地的 OpenStreetMap 道路與小徑，然後在本地計算迴圈路線。令人沮喪的是，它實際執行的程式碼以及所做所為的確切細節，在 ChatGPT 的使用者介面中對我而言是不可見的。我認為這種缺乏透明度的設計是一個反功能（anti-feature）。等到我想到要索取它所使用的 Python 程式碼副本時，ChatGPT 已經無法提供。這似乎是因為執行緒（thread）已經被壓縮（compacted）了。我認為任何使用壓縮機制的 LLM 系統，都需要同時保留壓縮前的文字，並透過代理程式工具呼叫（agent tool calls）提供這些文字，以防範這類問題。至於向我顯示地圖的部分，則是使用了視覺化技能。它建立了一個名為 /workspace/el-granada-5k-share.html 的檔案，直接嵌入到 ChatGPT 的使用者介面中。以下是該 HTML 的副本，開頭如下：< div id =" eg-share-loop " > < div class =" viz-row " > < h3 > El Granada harbor loop </ h3 > < span class =" text-small " > 5.1 km </ span > </ div > < div id =" eg-share-stage " > </ div > < div class =" text-small text-muted " > Map data © < a href =" https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright " target =" _blank " rel =
